_about: Adam's Logos purchase 'Classic Commentaries and Studies on Daniel Upgrade (17 vols)' (receipt June 2017), its titles as listed on logos.com read 2026-11-03, each found as a pre-1931 Internet Archive scan and its title page read. One shelf for the bundle because its 17 authors mostly have one book each; works already on another shelf are not repeated here (listed under _excluded). Internet Archive OCR, raw. All pre-1931, so US public domain. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A. No uids minted.

ccd-newton-observations: Isaac Newton, Observations upon the Prophecies of Daniel, new ed. with the citations translated and notes by P. Borthwick (London: James Nisbet, 1831)
ccd-harrison-prophetic-outlines: Benjamin Harrison, Prophetic Outlines of the Christian Church and the Antichristian Power, as Traced in the Visions of Daniel and St. John: Twelve Lectures (London: F. & J. Rivington, 1849)
ccd-wodrow-past-history-israel: Robert Wodrow, The Past History and Future Destiny of Israel, as Unfolded in the Eighth and Succeeding Chapters of the Book of Daniel (Glasgow: Blackie, 1844; catalogue date)
ccd-miles-daniel-1: Charles Popham Miles, Lectures, Expository and Practical, on the Book of the Prophet Daniel, first series: chapters I-VI (London: James Nisbet, 1840)
ccd-wilson-horae-propheticae: Joseph Wilson, Horae Propheticae: or, Dissertations on the Book of the Prophet Daniel (Oundle: T. and E. Bell, 1824)
ccd-wintle-daniel: Thomas Wintle, Daniel, an Improved Version Attempted, with a Preliminary Dissertation and Notes (Oxford, 1792; ECCO scan)
ccd-haskell-story-of-daniel: Stephen N. Haskell, The Story of Daniel the Prophet (South Lancaster, Mass.: Bible Training School, 1908)
ccd-oswald-kingdom: J. Oswald, The Kingdom which Shall Not Be Destroyed: An Exposition of Prophecy, More Especially of Daniel, Chap. VII (Philadelphia: J. B. Lippincott, 1856)
ccd-taylor-times-of-daniel: Henry W. Taylor, The Times of Daniel: An Argument (New York: Anson D. F. Randolph, 1871)
